//.typescript: PINNED >=5.9 <6.1 — not an open floor. Two measured reasons, both needed. (1) Unconstrained, an open floor resolves to TypeScript 7: `npm view typescript dist-tags` gives latest 7.0.2, and typescript-eslint@8 publishes peer `typescript: >=4.8.4 <6.1.0`, so TS 7 breaks the ESLint gate outright. (2) With typescript-eslint present npm back-solves rather than failing — the same open floor resolves to 6.0.3, not 7 — so the pin's job is also to keep the constraint explicit and OWNED HERE instead of emergent from a transitive peer that a future bump could relax silently. openapi-typescript's `typescript: ^5.x` peer is what lands the resolved version on 5.9.x. Decided in story c2-1 (AC 4).
//.eslint: PINNED ^9 — eslint@10 CANNOT coexist with eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y. jsx-a11y@6.10.2 is `latest` (no newer release) and peers at `eslint ^3 || ... || ^9`; ESLint's own `latest` dist-tag is 10.x, so an unpinned eslint makes `npm ci` fail with ERESOLVE — not warn. Raising ESLint deletes the UX-DR47 accessibility gate. EXIT CONDITION: lift this pin when eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y publishes an ^10 peer range. Decided in story c2-1 (AC 5, Decide-once #1, Ruling B3 — which also declined oxlint outright).
//.openapi-typescript: Installed by story c2-1 (Ruling B2) and deliberately UNWIRED — there is no generation script, no ui/src/api/types.d.ts and no CI step in this story. Story c2-3 owns wiring it. It lives here now so the lockfile lands on typescript@5.9.x from the first commit, instead of c2-3 having to downgrade TypeScript under two stories of existing code. devDependencies only, never dependencies (c2-3's own AC).
//.@testing-library/jest-dom: PINNED ~6.9.1 — a THIRD load-bearing pin, found while implementing c2-1 (the story predicted two). Both `latest` (7.0.0) and 6.10.0 declare `engines.node >= 22`, which is above this project's declared floor of >=20.19.0 and above the CI job's `node-version: 20`; 6.10.0 is additionally deprecated upstream as an incorrect minor release. 6.9.1 is the last release with `engines.node >= 14`. Lifting this pin requires raising the whole project's Node floor to 22 (an AC 2 / AC 15 change), not just bumping the dependency. Verified with `npm view @testing-library/jest-dom@<v> engines`.
